head: df957f99a6e544cde5a698cfb6d9685e92ee3255
assessment_scope: Complete declared Savia/FLUJO hackathon submission: deterministic R0-R18 core, implemented conversational enhancements, expandable architecture, data/ML/analytics and committed evidence.

dimensions.name: Technical judgment
dimensions.reason: Real ordered policy, ownership/readback/consent/recovery and query scope boundaries, appropriate generic/domain separation, and source-pinned qualification. Small claim and operation-status ambiguities remain; no core correctness blocker found in the selected checks.

dimensions.name: AI engineering
dimensions.reason: Integrated ES/PT text and voice, genuine two-role model completions, durable saved recommendations, exact playback admission, canonical host narration and rigorous fleet result correlation. Recorded reviewers choose bounded enums rather than conduct broad investigation; newest voice changes are source-qualified without new live comprehension evidence, and no broad answer-quality uplift is shown.

dimensions.name: Data engineering
dimensions.reason: Contracts, typed stages, quarantine, row accounting, deterministic correction/deduplication, source lineage, customer buckets and atomic publication are substantive and replayed. Historical ownership/template defects changed product choices. A reproducible report failure can leave a nonzero run after publication; S3 inventory lacks VersionId pinning as disclosed.

dimensions.name: ML/evaluation
dimensions.reason: Training-only CV, preserved frozen diagnostic, keyword/raw/abstention comparisons, language/error slices and paired uncertainty are useful. Required independent human label adjudication remains pending; safety/coverage tradeoff is substantial. Luna's audited 100/100 result covers 10 request phrasings and ties the deterministic baseline; it is not broad quality or product improvement.

dimensions.name: Data analytics
dimensions.reason: Metadata-only read-only extraction, HMAC identities, outcome/evidence separation, explicit denominators, uncertainty and operating decisions are implemented and tested. Cost/token persistence, exact workflow-turn attribution and lifetime card-action analysis remain incomplete; tiny customer samples cannot quantify impact.

first_five_findings_in_discovery_order.finding: README's 'Same admission rules a production host would use' extends beyond what a fictional ledger and source checks prove.
Product boundary deliberately keeps Savia/banking code outside generic FLUJO main; local copied public generic interfaces make platform contribution inspectable.

Pitch/architecture describe 100 team conversations as a larger design; recorded customer collaboration is two reviewers. The documented later failed provider attempt is separate from successful capacity receipts.
ElevenLabs comparison offers useful product positioning but no matched benchmark or executed capability parity study; vendor latency and Savia end-to-end timings are not interchangeable.
R0-R18 is an implemented pure ordered policy with trusted identity, query-scoped confirmation, receipt matching and runtime recovery, not just a prompt/diagram.

defects_and_gaps.finding: External report.write occurs after CURRENT publication. A generated six-table run with reports/manifest.json occupied by a directory raises PermissionError after CURRENT advances; the new build is complete and prior build retained.
defects_and_gaps.impact: Failed CLI outcome is ambiguous about active snapshot; no corrupt data or failed-contract publication demonstrated.
defects_and_gaps.improvement: Write required external report before publication, or explicitly separate a post-commit optional-report failure from build/publication failure.

defects_and_gaps.finding: Independent human adjudication is expressly required before final submission but remains pending.
defects_and_gaps.impact: Limits learned-quality conclusions; not a reason to discard deterministic core and implemented submission.
defects_and_gaps.improvement: Preserve blind human worksheets/disagreements, version adjudicated labels separately, and use a new untouched set for subsequent development.

defects_and_gaps.finding: Two real reviewer calls choose fixed suggestion enums and trusted templates. The provider fixture benchmark ties code; general usefulness/fluency and richer investigation quality are unmeasured.
defects_and_gaps.improvement: Compare these model choices against deterministic suggestions on varied, independently judged real-style cases before expanding the complexity.

defects_and_gaps.finding: Exact turn/query outcome attribution, persistent usage/cost and lifetime card action analytics are unavailable.
defects_and_gaps.improvement: Add authenticated stable outcome linkage and usage observations while preserving metadata minimization and honest denominators.

defects_and_gaps.finding: Production-admission equivalence, 'ready to scale' and two-person/ten-day phrasing should keep their existing qualifications visible.
defects_and_gaps.improvement: Describe production-like control patterns, implemented scale contracts and owner-supplied active delivery scope instead of implying completed production/fleet acceptance.

submission_blocker: No discovered blocker to the declared bounded hackathon handover. Human label adjudication remains an unresolved gate for stronger learned-component quality claims. Video destination/placeholder, larger fleet qualification and real-bank qualification are separate scopes and were not scored as missing hackathon implementation.

comparison_quality.routing: Strong component comparison: committed 70/120 keyword, 94/120 raw classifier, 65/120 abstention; paired raw uplift 20 points with 10-30-point interval; human misses 13/30, 3/30, 1/30 and unnecessary handoffs 6/90, 9/90, 52/90. AI-label and sample caveats remain.
comparison_quality.luna: Transparent actual records and independently derived fixture baseline; 100/100 both systems. Five scenarios and 10 phrases establish exact grounding/transport load, not AI advantage or general conversational quality.
comparison_quality.infrastructure: Preserves 217/300 first wording and 300/300 neutral reference repeat, queue-inclusive latency and sandbox failures. Original private request histories unavailable here; aggregate receipts remain historical evidence, not current customer acceptance.
comparison_quality.commercial: Useful bank-controlled case-lifecycle positioning with dated vendor citations and explicit lack of matched performance benchmark. Does not establish product superiority, lower cost, lower latency or absence of equivalent third-party tooling.

checks.name: audio byte/container verification
checks.limit: No human listening/comprehension or waveform/script alignment claim.

checks.name: operating metrics reconstruction
checks.limit: Recomputed published predictions and paired intervals, not fresh model fitting.

failed_or_unavailable_checks.result: Final fixed-router evaluation unavailable: ModuleNotFoundError: sklearn. Prior 67 tests and all 11 invariants passed; no final replay receipt is claimed. No dependencies installed.
Initial shorthand invocation lacked documented --experimental-strip-types and failed with ERR_UNKNOWN_FILE_EXTENSION. Correct documented invocation passed five checks.

Initial whole report-directory-as-file probe correctly failed before CURRENT changed; its scratch assertion assuming otherwise failed. A separate late manifest-path failure reproduced publication/status ambiguity.

limits: Only the requested frozen evidence worktree was read; no earlier assessment/rating reports were opened and no other reviewer, repository, chat, web, provider or bank was consulted.
No live site/browser, provider requests, physical microphone tests, external deployment or bank actions.
No installs; scikit-learn unavailable and frontend node_modules absent. Full frontend build/UI suite, nine upstream suites/full FLUJO build and full cross-platform/all-repository CI were not rerun.
Historical 5,899,720-row aggregate/source report and private infrastructure raw traces were assessed as committed receipts, not independently rerun on private data.
Historical recordings qualify their original sources. Current canonical narration improvements have mock/source evidence; no new live voice acceptance is inferred.
Existing fixtures/doubles test real domain code; Python network guards are instrumentation, not an OS sandbox.

Scratch artifacts were confined to the requested .tmp/quality-review-1 prefix; the first committed core harness used pytest's normal temporary fixture location because it has no basetemp option. Later fixture/replay work explicitly used the assigned scratch temp directory.
